Instruction: Read the segment of a merger agreement and answer the multiple-choice question by choosing the option that best characterizes the agreement.
Question: At what points are the representations and warranties required to be true according to the bring down provision?
Option A: Only at Closing
Option B: At Signing and at Closing

Merger Agreement: Section 6.3 Conditions to Closing. The obligations of the Acquirer to consummate the transactions contemplated by this Agreement are subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions: (a) the representations and warranties of the Company set forth in this Agreement shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the date of this Agreement and as of the Closing Date, except for such failures that would not, individually or in the aggregate, have a Material Adverse Effect; (b) the Company shall have delivered a certificate confirming the accuracy of the representations and warranties as of the Closing Date, and the representations and warranties made as of the date of this Agreement shall be deemed to be re-made at Closing as if made at that time, except for those that expressly speak as of a specific date.

Merger Agreement: Section 8.1 Conditions to the Obligations of the Buyer. The obligations of the Buyer to consummate the transactions contemplated by this Agreement are subject to the satisfaction or waiver by the Buyer at or prior to the Closing Date of the following conditions: (a) the representations and warranties of the Seller contained in this Agreement shall be true and correct in all respects as of the Closing Date, except for such failures to be true and correct as would not, individually or in the aggregate, have a Material Adverse Effect; (b) the representations and warranties of the Seller that are specifically made as of a certain date shall be deemed true and correct only as of that specific date; (Page 50)

Merger Agreement: Section 5.4 Representations and Warranties. Each representation and warranty of the Seller contained in this Agreement must be accurate both at the time of execution of this Agreement and at the Closing Date, as if restated at the Closing Date, provided that any inaccuracies that do not result in a Material Adverse Effect shall not be deemed to violate this requirement.
